subject.title: skill_workshop apply times out ("Approval timed out") on large proposals (~28KB)

question: Should maintainers make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100498 the canonical fix for this issue, use the narrower timeout-only approach in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/94315, or choose another approval contract?
rationale: Current main still has the bug, and the open fixes differ on security/UX behavior: a narrow longer timeout versus a broader bounded approval prompt with proposal metadata and an actionable timeout result.

options.title: Canonicalize broader lifecycle fix
options.body: Review and land or revise https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100498 because it addresses the watchdog mismatch, proposal context, and non-wedging timeout result together.

options.title: Use timeout-only repair
options.body: Proceed with the narrower timeout-only PR if maintainers want minimal behavior change and will keep popup/context improvements separate.

options.title: Hold for a different contract
options.body: Pause both PRs if maintainers want a configurable or protocol-level approval deadline contract instead of a static Skill Workshop policy.

recommendation.title: Canonicalize broader lifecycle fix
recommendation.body: Review and land or revise https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100498 because it addresses the watchdog mismatch, proposal context, and non-wedging timeout result together.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the current assignee and author of the broader open fix that explicitly closes this issue.
